name: nested collection relationship digests
description: Eight similar four-collection product groups. Nested batches add complete groups, so every larger batch contains more gold relationships and more same-role hard negatives.

collections.name: Atlas product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Atlas merchant checkout requirements, refund behavior, and the customer-facing payment experience.

collections.name: Atlas application
collections.digest: The Atlas TypeScript application implements the checkout and refund workflows approved in Atlas product decisions. It calls the Atlas Ledger service for balances and settlement.

collections.name: Atlas customer documentation
collections.digest: Explains the Atlas checkout and refund behavior defined by Atlas product decisions for merchants integrating payments.

collections.name: Atlas Ledger service
collections.digest: Operates the balance and settlement API consumed by the Atlas application. It is not used by the other product applications.

collections.name: Beacon product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Beacon incident triage, escalation, and responder-notification behavior for operations teams.

collections.name: Beacon application
collections.digest: The Beacon Go application implements the incident workflows approved in Beacon product decisions. It calls Beacon Paging to notify responders.

collections.name: Beacon responder handbook
collections.digest: Documents the Beacon triage and escalation behavior defined by Beacon product decisions for incident responders.

collections.name: Beacon Paging service
collections.digest: Operates the responder notification API consumed by the Beacon application. It is independent of the payment and hiring systems.

collections.name: Cedar product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Cedar candidate intake, interview scheduling, and hiring-team review behavior.

collections.name: Cedar application
collections.digest: The Cedar Ruby application implements the candidate and interview workflows approved in Cedar product decisions. It calls Cedar Calendar for availability.

collections.name: Cedar recruiting guide
collections.digest: Documents the Cedar candidate and interview behavior defined by Cedar product decisions for recruiters and interviewers.

collections.name: Cedar Calendar service
collections.digest: Operates the interview availability API consumed by the Cedar application. It does not schedule incidents or customer messages.

collections.name: Drift product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Drift analytics dashboards, metric exploration, and scheduled report behavior.

collections.name: Drift application
collections.digest: The Drift Python application implements the dashboard and report workflows approved in Drift product decisions. It queries Drift Metrics for aggregates.

collections.name: Drift analytics manual
collections.digest: Documents the Drift dashboard and reporting behavior defined by Drift product decisions for analysts.

collections.name: Drift Metrics service
collections.digest: Operates the aggregate-query API consumed by the Drift application. Its data is unrelated to responder paging.

collections.name: Ember product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Ember campaign composition, audience selection, and scheduled customer-message delivery.

collections.name: Ember application
collections.digest: The Ember Kotlin application implements the campaign workflows approved in Ember product decisions. It sends deliveries through Ember Dispatch.

collections.name: Ember messaging guide
collections.digest: Documents the Ember campaign and audience behavior defined by Ember product decisions for marketing operators.

collections.name: Ember Dispatch service
collections.digest: Operates the outbound delivery API consumed by the Ember application. It does not process checkout settlements.

collections.name: Fjord product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Fjord subscription plans, invoice correction, and account-credit behavior.

collections.name: Fjord application
collections.digest: The Fjord Java application implements the subscription and invoice workflows approved in Fjord product decisions. It calls Fjord Rating for charge calculations.

collections.name: Fjord billing guide
collections.digest: Documents the Fjord subscription and invoice behavior defined by Fjord product decisions for account administrators.

collections.name: Fjord Rating service
collections.digest: Operates the charge-calculation API consumed by the Fjord application. It is separate from the Atlas settlement ledger.

collections.name: Grove product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Grove knowledge publishing, review, and internal-search behavior.

collections.name: Grove application
collections.digest: The Grove Rust application implements the publishing and search workflows approved in Grove product decisions. It indexes content through Grove Search.

collections.name: Grove author handbook
collections.digest: Documents the Grove publishing and review behavior defined by Grove product decisions for knowledge authors.

collections.name: Grove Search service
collections.digest: Operates the indexing and query API consumed by the Grove application. It does not provide analytics aggregates.

collections.name: Harbor product decisions
collections.digest: Defines Harbor organization login, session management, and administrator access controls.

collections.name: Harbor application
collections.digest: The Harbor Elixir application implements the login and access workflows approved in Harbor product decisions. It validates identities through Harbor Directory.

collections.name: Harbor administrator guide
collections.digest: Documents the Harbor login and access behavior defined by Harbor product decisions for organization administrators.

collections.name: Harbor Directory service
collections.digest: Operates the identity validation API consumed by the Harbor application. It is not a recruiting candidate directory.
